semantics: img_sub is grouped by deployment_id and sp before independence intervals are calculated
ind_dat is one row per unique event_id
ind_dat is filtered to known active camera days using substr(timestamp,1,10) plus placename
ind_dat$sp is exported directly after factor conversion
write.csv(ind_dat, ...30min_independent_detections.csv) occurs without a select or rename step

focal_taxon.token_evidence: public Algar common_names.csv and activity code
focal_taxon.normalization: strip outer whitespace only; case-sensitive exact match

candidate_join.deployment_join: exact stripped deployment_id to the frozen 114-deployment safe source
candidate_join.placename_check: exact stripped placename must equal the node_id attached to the matched frozen deployment
candidate_join.phase_assignment: phase1/phase2/phase3 inherited solely from the frozen response-independent deployment ordering

timestamp_validation.required_prefix: first 10 characters must parse as ISO YYYY-MM-DD
timestamp_validation.matched_deployment_sanity_check: response date must lie between frozen start_date and end_date inclusive for the matched deployment; otherwise terminal row-schema stop

event_semantics.initialization_positive: phase1 node is positive iff at least one matched exact caribou event exists
event_semantics.scored_positive: eligible phase2/phase3 unit is positive iff at least one matched exact caribou event exists
event_semantics.scored_negative: eligible phase2/phase3 unit with zero matched exact caribou events is a recorded camera non-detection under complete-source-zero

source_completeness_justification.basis: public generation code writes the complete independent-event table after filtering detections to known active camera days; frozen effort ledger independently enumerates surveyed candidate units
source_completeness_justification.zero_rule: eligible candidate unit absent from focal-taxon independent-event rows is zero/non-detection
source_completeness_justification.completeness_failure_policy: terminal_stop_if_payload/header evidence contradicts required generator contract
